attachments.origin_landmark: pterygoid plate, pterygomandibular raphe, mylohyoid line of mandible

innervation.root_levels: CN X (via pharyngeal plexus; CN IX contributes sensory fibers to the plexus)

actions: constricts the pharynx in swallowing (sequential wave with middle/inferior constrictors)

functional_compartments.name: Single fiber population
functional_compartments.function_note: Most superior of the 3 overlapping pharyngeal constrictors, forming a funnel-shaped muscular tube with the middle and inferior constrictors; contracts in a coordinated superior-to-inferior peristaltic sequence during swallowing.
functional_compartments.source: Gray's Anatomy for Students, 4th ed. (Drake, Vogl, Mitchell); Terminologia Anatomica (FICAT 1998)
